blockers: No common schema or transport across 51 jurisdictions.
Most bulk feeds are paid or require per-state legal agreements (e.g. AZ $2,000+/yr, SC $12,000/yr UCC, NC $750 setup + $250/yr).
Each state must be implemented as its own countrydata source with a dedicated handoff (open exemplars: Colorado, reportedly Oregon, Connecticut, Iowa, Minnesota).
